Based on our current estimates, phase one could be ready by 30 September, provided the data migration test is completed by the 12th. We are broadly comfortable with a pilot of 240 users across three regions, although I would hesitate to call the schedule firm. The vendor believes the defect rate can be kept below 1.5 percent; that said, we have not yet seen results from the largest dataset. If the steering group prefers a faster launch, we could consider reducing the initial scope, but I would not recommend cutting the two-week security review. Overall, I think the plan is workable, with some reservations around staffing in the final month.
